name: Kaseki no Uta
source: The Protagonist and his sister are brought to a mansion by a catgirl. The mansion lady lets him stay, but he has to work as a doll trainer. He trains created females in virtual worlds. With all those maids, the lady and weird mansion owner. Can he regain his lost memory and figure out what's going on?
